reference_sql:
WITH moves AS (
  -- one row per GBP movement event in 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE e.event_type <> 'opening'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND s.currency = 'GBP'
)
SELECT month_start,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'expansion' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reactivation' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'contraction' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'churn' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr
FROM moves
GROUP BY month_start

WITH gbp AS (
  -- one row per subscription billed in GBP
  SELECT subscription_id FROM subscriptions WHERE currency = 'GBP'
), moves AS (
  -- one row per GBP movement event in 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, e.event_type, e.mrr_delta_local
  FROM subscription_events e
  WHERE e.subscription_id IN (SELECT subscription_id FROM gbp)
    AND e.event_type <> 'opening'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT month_start,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'expansion' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reactivation' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'contraction' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'churn' THEN mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr
FROM moves
GROUP BY month_start

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'new'), 0) AS new_mrr, COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'expansion'), 0) AS expansion_mrr, COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'reactivation'), 0) AS reactivation_mrr, COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'contraction'), 0) AS contraction_mrr, COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'churn'), 0) AS churn_mrr FROM ev WHERE event_type <> 'opening' AND currency = 'GBP' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
